whenToUse: Login and email verification codes, typed or pasted one character per slot
Numeric PINs and digit only codes that ignore any letter typed into them
Fixed length codes of letters and numbers, split into groups by separators

whenNotToUse.when: A complete sign-in page with password, social buttons and a brand layout
A mobile number with its country dial code, entered before any code is sent
Open ended text of any length, such as a name, an email address or a password

agentNotes: A wrong code turns red only from aria-invalid on each `InputOTPSlot`; set on `InputOTP` it reaches the hidden input and the slots stay plain
Read the code from `onChange` on `InputOTP` and check it once it reaches `maxLength`; no example sends or verifies it
